clauses.title: Every tooling failure stays terminal
requires: a running gate waits, and every other helper refusal stops `BLOCKED`
a recovery consumes no counter, exactly as a tool failure does not consume a round
clauses.section: ## CL-D39 — Exact autofix gains one bounded pre-writer recovery

clauses.title: Bounded pre-writer recovery
requires: One recovery is permitted per operation and phase
no Luna task, commit, push, or reply exists
one canonical `operation@phase` key that its replacement retains
invalidating only the failed operation's own output
grants no resume, no second writer, no repeated provider mutation

clauses.title: The autofix driver relaunches at most once per run and never after the writer
The authority baseline is raised for the closed mapping
clauses.section: ## CL-D39 — Exact autofix gains one bounded pre-writer recovery
requires: raises the six-file authority baseline from 112,000 to 116,000 bytes
the shortfall is funded by the raise rather than by a trim
